stem: A grower records one PPFD reading directly under the center of a fixture and uses it to represent the entire canopy. What is the main limitation?
choices: PPFD can only be measured after harvest
PPFD already includes the entire day's photoperiod
One center reading automatically equals the canopy minimum
A single point cannot characterize spatial distribution or edge-to-center variation
rationale: PPFD can vary substantially across a canopy. A repeatable measurement grid is needed to characterize distribution rather than relying on one point.
